questions.stem: A 30-Year-old P2+0 female presents to the emergency department with a complaint of pain in the right breast on postpartum day ten from an uncomplicated spontaneous vaginal delivery at 40 weeks. Initially, there was no problem with breastfeeding, but for the past two days, the right nipple has become dry and cracked, and since yesterday it has become increasingly swollen and painful. On G/E – her temp. is 101 degrees F. Local examination- right nipple was warm and red. NO fluctuant, induration or no pus can be expressed. What should be the next step in the management of this patient?

options.label: B
options.text: Breastfeed from the unaffected breast only.

options.label: C
options.text: Immediately start antibiotics and discontinue breastfeeding until on antibiotics.

options.label: D
options.text: Pump and discard breastmilk until the infection is over, and continue breastfeeding.
